name: bbport for Windows
requires: Your own decrypted Bloodborne dump (CUSA03173, v1.09 for the 60 FPS patches). Pick its folder once in the bbport launcher.
blurb: The original PS4 game running natively on Windows, with Vulkan rendering, DLSS/FSR, unlocked frame rate and online play. Built on deadinside28's bbport.

name: God of War III Remastered for PC
requires: Your own PS4 dump of God of War III Remastered (CUSA01623, update 01.02): the folder with eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys. Pick it once in the launcher.
blurb: The original PS4 game running natively on Windows, with shadPS4's Vulkan video core, a 240 FPS patch, in-game menu and cheats. A fork of the bbport lineage by FelipePrado0.
